findings.result: Each native header binds its own physically pinned immutable original_operation descriptor. Guardian accounting_input binds the aggregate manifest; the sealed index ties both without circular contexts. Reused precheck/cell arms remain distinct 37 operation IDs.

Builder requires a caller validator over a row deep copy and read-only physically read original bytes, rejects a refusal return or mutated row, and verifies original descriptors before and after write. Callback and pinned plan are not scientific/source acceptance themselves. Actual caller must retain stock source/worker/model validators.

The loader holds all enumerated index/manifest/inventory/context/original leaf handles and rechecks leaf epochs, bytes, hashes, original paths and stock PhysicalRootCustody ancestor identities. Allowing unrelated sibling creation removes only parent mtime exclusivity. Actual same-bytes source leaf ABA and ancestor symlink substitution tests reject the changes.

Binder selects the held original arm, matches all operation coordinates/windows/cardinality, and compares candidate/calibration refs with actual stock pins. Under-root absolute descriptors use relative_to without resolve, then existing physical descriptor pin. Original header/context bytes and original contract remain unchanged.

Actual 37-row builder output with absolute context/candidate/calibration descriptors loads into the binder, then four real wrapper functions. GStreamer/OpenVINO native context paths use /workspace/project; DeepStream/Savant SDK paths use /opt/vast/input/operational/native-context.json. Distinct capture mount and original legacy namespace checks execute.

Original child failure and precommit failure after separate capture commit retain the original cause and evidence. An orphan final capture stops a new attempt before request, collector or runtime creation. True ancestor-alias retention rejects redirection and preserves private staging.

Lazy original ingress provider is called once per actual operation and rejects equal-count foreign stream mapping. Real coordinator/front/recorder/cold fixture reconciles 12 actual all-phase requests versus 4 measured decisions; legitimate cross-operation wire duplication remains a multiset. New returned per-operation counts were reread and included in latest stable regression.

limitations: Inference backend and runtime Docker CLI remain explicitly local fixtures. No physical runtime image, actual model inference, fresh host/source/parity or qualification receipt is accepted by these tests.

The held loader validates physically pinned internally consistent facts, not a scientific grant. Actual callers must enforce stock original-operation/model/worker/candidate/calibration/source authority.
Diagnostic table bounds do not themselves select the reviewed static_hybrid primary pair. Actual diagnostic caller must enforce that scope and nonpromoting permission.
Four affected runtime builds and fresh source/host/parity authority remain required. Existing dated image IDs and publication grants are invalidated by the source changes.
Two diagnostic arms, complete 37-operation cold caller, scientific qualification/Q4/full matrix, required checks, conformance, CI and archive are not shown complete by this local review.

self_review.answer: No. It proves a necessary local repair of the all-phase versus measured identity defect and the path into existing production wrappers. Promoting fixture success as physical benchmark acceptance would repeat the prior architectural failure.
